title: 激光切割机2：安全

author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/02_Laser Cutter 2 Safety/src.py

points.K1: 材料之外，还有几条规矩
points.K5: 急停按钮：情况严重时用
points.K6: 少量烟和小火苗是正常的
points.K10: 触发后断电、喷二氧化碳
points.K11: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
points.K12: 灭火毯和灭火器是下一步

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台运行中的桌面式激光切割机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a running desktop laser cutter with a closed tinted lid and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光切割机运行时的安全。
overlay: 激光切割机的运行安全

shots.scene: 眼睛、暂停键、急停按钮、灭火器四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an open eye, a pause button, a red emergency stop button and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 守得住、停得下、灭得了。

shots.scene: 阿杰启动激光切割机后，转身走向房间另一头的同学
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts the laser cutter, then turns and walks toward friends chatting at the far side of the room.
shots.narration: 阿杰开了机，就想去那边聊天。

shots.scene: 机器里木板上冒出一小簇火苗，旁边没人
shots.prompt_en: Inside the closed laser cutter, a small flame flickers on a wooden board while nobody is near the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 这时，木板上冒出了一小簇火苗。

shots.scene: 小研快步上前按下暂停键，招手叫阿杰回来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over, presses the pause button on top of the laser cutter and waves the young male student back.
shots.narration: 小研按下暂停，把阿杰叫了回来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 开了机就走开，是最危险的习惯。

shots.section_title: 材料之外，还有几条规矩
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块木板，旁边是一张空白材料清单打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a plain wooden board next to a blank approved materials list with a green check.
shots.narration: 只用批准的材料，这是第一步。
overlay: 材料之外，还有几条规矩

shots.section_title: 材料之外，还有几条规矩
shots.scene: 几张空白规则卡片排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of blank rule cards with simple icons: an eye, a pause button, a stop button and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 运行时，还有几条规矩要遵守。

shots.scene: 小研站在运行中的激光切割机旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside a running desktop laser cutter, watching it closely.
shots.narration: 最重要的一条：运行全程，人不离机。

shots.scene: 切割、雕刻、划线三个图标都连着一个小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons for cutting, engraving and scoring, each connected to a small person icon standing by the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 切割、雕刻、划线，都一样。

shots.scene: 机器旁空无一人的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a running laser cutter with nobody beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只要机器在走你的设计，就得守着。

shots.scene: 小研站在机旁，手臂伸出正好够到机器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands next to the laser cutter, her arm stretched out just reaching the top of the machine.
shots.narration: 距离要求：伸手就能够到。

shots.scene: 透过观察窗看到机内的木板和激光头
shots.prompt_en: A view through the tinted window of the laser cutter showing a wooden board and the laser head inside. No people.
shots.narration: 站的位置，要能看见机器里面。

shots.scene: 小研站在机旁，一边在笔记本上画下一个设计，一边抬头看机器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside the laser cutter, sketching her next design on a laptop and glancing up at the machine.
shots.narration: 可以在旁边用电脑做下一个设计。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在机旁低头看手机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands right beside the running laser cutter, looking at his phone.
shots.narration: 在旁边看看手机，也没关系。

shots.scene: 欣欣摆摆手，表示不用一直盯着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw casually beside the laser cutter, looking relaxed.
shots.narration: 不必一直盯着，只要人在旁边。

shots.scene: 走到房间另一头聊天、做别的作品的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person chatting far across the room and a person working at a sewing machine, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不能走远聊天，也不能去做别的活。

shots.scene: 激光切割机顶部的启动暂停按键特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a round start and pause button on the top panel of the laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 机器顶部，有启动和暂停键。

shots.scene: 小研伸手按下暂停键
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reaches over and presses the pause button on top of the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 运行中按暂停，永远没有坏处。

shots.scene: 机内木板上一簇小火苗，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Inside the laser cutter, a small flame on a wooden board, with a question mark icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看到小火苗或不对劲，先暂停。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标，小研隔着观察窗观察
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon; the female graduate student watches through the window of the paused laser cutter.
shots.narration: 停一会儿，看看情况再说。

shots.scene: 欣欣示意站近的好处
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands close to a laser cutter and reaches its paw toward the pause button.
shots.narration: 站得近，就是为了随时能按到。

shots.section_title: 急停按钮：情况严重时用
shots.scene: 激光切割机后角的红色急停按钮特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a red mushroom-shaped emergency stop button at the back corner of the laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 机器后角，还有一个急停按钮。
overlay: 急停按钮：情况严重时用

shots.section_title: 急停按钮：情况严重时用
shots.scene: 激光头卡住不动、伴有抖动线的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the laser head stuck on its rail with shaking lines around it. No people.
shots.narration: 激光头卡住了，想动又动不了。

shots.section_title: 急停按钮：情况严重时用
shots.scene: 机器图标旁出现碎裂声波纹
shots.prompt_en: A laser cutter icon with jagged sound wave lines and a small broken gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 听到像零件断裂的声音。

shots.section_title: 急停按钮：情况严重时用
shots.scene: 机器内充满浓烟的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a laser cutter with thick dark smoke filling the inside, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 看到让人担心的大量浓烟。

shots.section_title: 少量烟和小火苗是正常的
shots.scene: 激光在木板上切出细线，冒出一缕轻烟
shots.prompt_en: Inside the laser cutter, the beam cuts a thin line in a wooden board with a light wisp of smoke rising. No people.
shots.narration: 激光加工，本来就会冒一点烟。
overlay: 少量烟和小火苗是正常的

shots.section_title: 少量烟和小火苗是正常的
shots.scene: 切割点上一闪而过的小火苗
shots.prompt_en: A tiny flicker of flame at the cutting point that quickly disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 有时还会闪出小火苗。

shots.section_title: 少量烟和小火苗是正常的
shots.scene: 示意图：激光把材料烧掉，留下一道缝
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a beam burning away a thin line of material and leaving a narrow gap in the board. No people.
shots.narration: 因为激光切割，就是把材料烧掉。

shots.scene: 小火苗逐渐变成大火苗的三格图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in sequence: a tiny flame, a bigger flame, a large flame, with an arrow and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 要警惕的，是小火苗越烧越大。

shots.scene: 激光头已移到别处，原处木板仍在燃烧
shots.prompt_en: Inside the laser cutter, the laser head has moved to another area while the earlier spot on the board is still burning. No people.
shots.narration: 激光已经移走，原处还在烧。

shots.scene: 暂停键和急停按钮两个图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A pause button icon and a red emergency stop button icon light up side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 这时就要准备按暂停或急停。

shots.scene: 暂停键图标旁出现绿色继续箭头
shots.prompt_en: A pause button icon with a green resume arrow next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 一般先按暂停，设计还能接着做。

shots.scene: 排风气流吹过，小火苗熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Air flow lines from the exhaust pass over a small flame inside the laser cutter and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 排风的气流，常常能把小火吹灭。

shots.scene: 急停按钮按下，电源图标熄灭，设计文件图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: A red emergency stop button pressed down, a power icon turning off and a design file icon turning grey. No people.
shots.narration: 急停会断电，设计就无法恢复了。

shots.scene: 小研果断拍下急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student firmly presses the red emergency stop button at the back corner of the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 情况严重，就直接按急停。

shots.scene: 激光切割机旁一个小黑盒，一根细管通进机内
shots.prompt_en: A small black box mounted beside the laser cutter with a thin tube leading into the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边这个小盒子，是自动灭火装置。

shots.scene: 小盒子发出监测波纹，盯着机内
shots.prompt_en: The small black box emits gentle scanning waves toward the inside of the laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 机器开着，它就一直在监测。

shots.scene: 小盒子上的指示灯闪烁，发出声音波纹
shots.prompt_en: The indicator light on the small black box flashes and sound wave lines come from it. No people.
shots.narration: 发现烟和火，它会发出声音。

shots.scene: 警报声越来越大，周围人都转过头来
shots.prompt_en: Large sound wave lines from the small black box; the female graduate student and the young male student turn their heads toward it.
shots.narration: 烟火太大，会像火警一样大声报警。

shots.section_title: 触发后断电、喷二氧化碳
shots.scene: 电源图标被切断
shots.prompt_en: A laser cutter icon with its power plug icon disconnected and a power symbol turning off. No people.
shots.narration: 报警时，它会切断激光电源。
overlay: 触发后断电、喷二氧化碳

shots.section_title: 触发后断电、喷二氧化碳
shots.scene: 小盒子向机内喷出白色气体，火苗被压灭
shots.prompt_en: The small black box sprays white gas through the tube into the closed laser cutter and the flame inside is smothered. No people.
shots.narration: 同时向机器里喷二氧化碳灭火。

shots.section_title: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
shots.scene: 欣欣双手向下压，示意冷静
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the air with both paws, gesturing everyone to stay calm.
shots.narration: 听到警报，先别慌。
overlay: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员

shots.section_title: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
shots.scene: 冲过去掀开盖子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand lifting the lid of a laser cutter during an alarm, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要冲过去开盖子。

shots.section_title: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
shots.scene: 盖子紧闭，机内充满白色气体
shots.prompt_en: The laser cutter lid stays closed while white gas fills the inside. No people.
shots.narration: 让灭火装置先把气体喷进去。

shots.section_title: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师招手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves his arm to call the safety administrator over from across the room.
shots.narration: 确认工作人员已经知道，没注意就招手。

shots.section_title: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
shots.scene: 王老师赶来，阿杰站在一旁听指示
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator arrives at the laser cutter and gives instructions; the young male student stands aside and listens.
shots.narration: 然后等待工作人员的指示。

shots.section_title: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
shots.scene: 人群慌乱奔跑大喊的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of people running and shouting in panic toward a building door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要恐慌，不用喊着冲出大楼。

shots.section_title: 警报响了：别开盖，叫工作人员
shots.scene: 欣欣耸耸肩，摊开双手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shrugs with open paws, looking calm.
shots.narration: 这时你什么都不用做。

shots.section_title: 灭火毯和灭火器是下一步
shots.scene: 激光切割机另一侧的灭火器标志、灭火器和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign on the wall above a fire extinguisher and a red fire blanket pouch beside the laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 机器另一侧，备有灭火毯和灭火器。
overlay: 灭火毯和灭火器是下一步

shots.section_title: 灭火毯和灭火器是下一步
shots.scene: 王老师取下灭火器，示意学生后退
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator takes down the fire extinguisher and signals the students to step back.
shots.narration: 气体灭不了，按工作人员指示使用。

shots.section_title: 灭火毯和灭火器是下一步
shots.scene: 灭火装置图标打勾，旁边清洁工具图标
shots.prompt_en: A small black box icon with a green check next to a clean tidy machine icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先让灭火装置工作，清理也更省事。

shots.scene: 灭火装置、灭火器都整齐地放在原位
shots.prompt_en: The small black box, the fire extinguisher and the fire blanket all sit unused in their places beside the laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 这些装置，到现在还一次没用过。

shots.scene: 材料清单和规则卡片都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank approved materials list and a blank rule card, both with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 用对材料、守好规矩，就能安心用。

shots.scene: 笔记本电脑上打开空白设计软件界面
shots.prompt_en: A laptop on the bench next to the laser cutter shows a blank design software window with simple shape icons. No people.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲设计软件和设计设置。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现一块木板和空白材料清单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating icon of a wooden board and a blank approved materials list.
shots.narration: 只用批准的材料。

shots.scene: 小人站在机旁、伸手够到机器的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing within arm's reach of a running laser cutter, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 运行全程，伸手可及、看得见。

shots.scene: 暂停键和急停按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: A pause button icon and a red emergency stop button icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 有异常先暂停，严重才急停。

shots.scene: 盖子紧闭和招手叫人的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed laser cutter lid and a hand waving for help. No people.
shots.narration: 警报响了不开盖，叫工作人员。

shots.scene: 灭火毯和灭火器图标，旁边一个人举手指挥
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire blanket and a fire extinguisher with a staff hand signal beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火毯、灭火器，听指示再用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的激光切割机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy, switched-off desktop laser cutter.
shots.narration: 人在机旁，心中有数，下次见！
